subject.title: Bug: preflight (budget-triggered) compaction hard-capped at ~60s, ignores compaction.timeoutSeconds

question: Which cancellation contract should required budget/preflight compaction use before this issue is considered fixed?
rationale: Current main still has the reported source path, while the open candidate PR changes cancellation semantics in a session-state path where preserving explicit stop/restart behavior is a maintainer compatibility choice.

options.title: Review and land the narrow cancellation fix
options.body: Use the open linked PR or an equivalent focused patch that filters lifecycle timeout aborts while preserving explicit cancellation and validating the reply/preflight contract.

options.title: Choose a config opt-out instead
options.body: Add or revive an explicit preflight-compaction gate only if maintainers want user-controlled fallback to overflow recovery as the product answer.

options.title: Defer pending exact-backend proof
options.body: Keep the issue open and require logs from the reporter's exact slow backend before changing the cancellation contract.

recommendation.title: Review and land the narrow cancellation fix
recommendation.body: Use the open linked PR or an equivalent focused patch that filters lifecycle timeout aborts while preserving explicit cancellation and validating the reply/preflight contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently merged related preflight compaction gate work and are the strongest maintainer-routing signal in this code path.
